label: Amortized KV cache append with bounded spare capacity
hypothesis: Primary decode repeatedly copies the full history via 48 torch.cat calls. Append new K/V into reusable capacity without changing stored values, attention scope, precision or offload placement.
evidence: A0000/diagnostics/decode-ma_offload-events/events.json: 3222798336 output bytes across 48 cats, 5.9039 ms summed instrumented stream spans out of 11.2209 ms total. These are diagnostic spans, not kernel timing or speedup claims.
planned_change: Inference-only append with bounded chunked spare capacity, lazy allocation on decode to preserve prefill path; fall back for unsupported/cache-transformation cases. No cached model outputs or token lookups.
correctness_gate: Bit-exact logits, hidden states and valid KV vs independent frozen concatenating cache; growing128, rollback, group/slot reuse, padding, GQA, shape switches and primary shape. Preserve differentiable/training and sliding-window behavior.

measurement_plan.confirmation: 10/10/3, at least3 independent alternating pairs if promising
measurement_plan.acceptance: full matrix and generation2/5/3 with matching baseline where needed; no resolved primary regression or offload memory loss

risks: Spare cache storage raises GPU memory; record backing capacity and peaks.
Cache views/rollback/reordering must not reuse stale or incompatible storage.
Noncontiguous batch strides must preserve exact attention results.
